about_the_game:
Scarred by a war that nobody remembers, SECTOR 80 is doomed space. Legends tell of a galaxy-spanning disaster and unfathomable treasure left in its wake. Many expeditions have been sent to SECTOR 80, but none have ever returned.

You are not supposed to be here. Something has gone terribly wrong.

Travel across the sector, scavenge what you can, and find out what really happened here.

Everything you find in SECTOR 80 is battered and abandoned. You must work with what you have: there are no fabricators, nano-scale 3D printers, or factories here.

Every part you find might be key to your next invention. A damaged battery might be a critical power source in a pinch, or perhaps an effective explosive in the right hands!

In MEANWHILE IN SECTOR 80, everything is a physical object with mass, heat, and stored energy. Solve puzzles, blast enemies apart, and optimize the power efficiency of your build to become unstoppable.

Long-term survival in the hostile system of SECTOR 80 is impossible. With no prospect of rescue, you are your only hope. You'll need both skill and creativity to solve the mystery of SECTOR 80 and live to tell the tale!

esrb.interactive_elements: We have an active Discord community where we interact live with players as we're working on new features. Players are encouraged to share any ideas and feedback in the community. We periodically share unstable builds of the game to get early feedback on features while they're still very rough, giving players a chance to shape the game's mechanics from an early stage.

short_description: MEANWHILE IN SECTOR 80 is an action-engineering game set in space. Featuring an all-in-one physics simulation, drag-and-drop engineering, and third person action combat. Engineer, explore, and fight — you might just escape SECTOR 80.
